Thanks for the context. A few procurement notes / suggested conditions for an invoice-only pilot:

1) Cap the pilot at $10,000 total under the temporary exception.
2) Provide SOC2 (or equivalent) and the completed onboarding form (we have the latter).
3) Net30 invoices to be submitted to AP with the company remit information and a designated PO contact even if no PO is issued initially (so we have a record).
4) Exception duration: up to 90 days, after which a PO or contract amendment required for further spend.

If Finance confirms they can allow up to $10k without a PO we can proceed. I'm attaching the procurement exception template I use for these cases — please fill and route.

Attachment: procurement_exception_request_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 42KB)

—David

David / team — Finance can approve a time-limited allowance for small pilots when the following conditions are met:

• Signed onboarding form or SOW (we have the form).
• Vendor provides SOC2 or equivalent evidence of controls.
• AP receives invoice with remit and vendor tax info; invoices routed to finance-ap@redwoodinference.com.
• Temporary cap: $10,000 for up to 90 days; any spend beyond requires a PO or an approved contract amendment.

I'll prepare the Finance-temp-allowlist-form; once David confirms the filled exception template we'll route to the Director of Finance for final sign-off. If the customer needs DocuSign for the SOW, include the link in your reply.

Attachment: Finance-temp-allowlist-form.pdf (application/pdf, 64KB)

Thanks,
Laura Bennett

Hi Aria — welcome again. Following procurement and finance review, we can provision Novapulse for the 60-day pilot on an invoice-only basis under a temporary exception with the following conditions:

• Pilot cap: $10,000 total spend.
• Exception duration: 90 days from provisioning date.
• Required evidence: signed onboarding form (we have), SOC2 report to be sent to procurement@redwoodinference.com, and AP remit details on invoice.
• Invoices: Net30, addressed to Redwood Inference AP; please copy finance-ap@redwoodinference.com.

Next steps for your team:
1) Upload SOC2 to the secure link or reply with the PDF.
2) Sign the short pilot SOW (DocuSign) — link below.
3) Fill the procurement exception template (David will confirm) and return to us.

DocuSign link (pilot SOW): https://app.docusign.com/START/ABC123-novapulse-onboard
Procurement exception record: https://redwood-drive.internal/procurement/exceptions/NP-2026-0421

Once the signed SOW and SOC2 are received, I will ask IT to activate the trial and AP to add Novapulse to the temporary allowlist.

Thanks and excited to partner,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
